title: Noir AI-context artifact
description: Distilled per-endpoint static context produced by `noir scan --ai-context` and written by src/dast_orchestrator/noir_runner.py. Phase 2 only produces and stores this; the Phase 3 LLM correlation pass is its consumer. Documented here so that contract is fixed before anything depends on it.

schema_version.description: Bumped whenever a consumer-visible field changes.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp, %Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ. Matches the sibling zap-alerts-<ts>.json of the same run.

noir_image.description: Pinned Noir image the artifact came from, e.g. ghcr.io/owasp-noir/noir:1.2.1. Never a :latest tag.

source_dir.description: Host path of the analysed source tree; must be the same version as the scanned target.

key.description: "<METHOD> <route template>", e.g. "POST /{username}/{reponame}/settings". The join key between this artifact and a ZAP finding. Note the template is NOT the concrete URL ZAP reports: correlation must match the ZAP URL back onto the template.

path.description: Route template as registered in source, with framework placeholders intact ({username}, {sha:[a-f0-9]{7,40}}, trailing *).

technology.description: Noir detector that produced the endpoint, e.g. go_chi.

code_paths.description: Where the route is registered. Feeds SARIF locations and gives the LLM a file:line to reason about.

tags.description: Noir tagger output, e.g. {name: auth, tagger: go_auth}.

ai_context.description: Noir's five context categories. Every category is always present; an empty array means Noir found nothing, not that the category is missing.

guards.description: Auth/authorisation middleware protecting the route. Primary signal for downgrading a ZAP access-control finding.

callees.description: Direct 1-hop functions called from the handler body.

sinks.description: Dangerous operations (redirect, exec, sql, path, ...). Primary signal for promoting a low-confidence ZAP alert to a rescan.

validators.description: Input validation/sanitisation applied before a sink.

signals.description: Route registration and detected technology; always at least the route_definition record.

signal.description: Uniform record shape Noir uses across all five categories.

kind.description: Category-specific type, e.g. auth_guard, redirect, request_input, route_definition.

source.description: Which Noir analyser emitted it, e.g. go_auth, callee, detector, route.

confidence.description: 0-100, Noir's own confidence. Carried through so the correlation pass can weight it rather than treating every signal as equally certain.

snippet.description: Surrounding source lines, ' | '-joined with line-number prefixes.
